mcqs.question: What does the review say characterises hepatopulmonary syndrome?

options.A: Intrapulmonary vascular dilatations and shunts that impair gas exchange
options.B: Pulmonary venous occlusion without liver disease
options.C: A normal A-a gradient by definition
options.D: Left-heart failure as the required cause

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Intrapulmonary vascular dilatations and shunts that impair gas exchange
mcqs.explanation: HPS is characterised by intrapulmonary vascular dilatations and shunts, resulting in impaired gas exchange.

sourceRefs.excerpt: The disease is characterised by intrapulmonary vascular dilatations and shunts, resulting in impaired gas exchange.

mcqs.question: What does the review call the only therapeutic option that generally reverses HPS?

options.B: Lung transplantation without treating the liver
options.E: There is no treatment that reverses HPS

mcqs.explanation: Liver transplantation is the only therapeutic option and generally reverses HPS.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Liver transplantation is the only therapeutic option and generally reverses HPS.

options.A: Significantly better than before that policy

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Significantly better than before that policy
mcqs.explanation: Since implementation of the MELD standard-exception policy, outcomes have been significantly better than previously.

mcqs.question: How does the review place HPS in relation to liver disease?

options.A: A pulmonary complication that adversely affects prognosis
options.B: A renal disease unrelated to the liver
options.C: A benign finding with no prognostic effect
options.E: A drug side effect of inhalers

mcqs.correctAnswerText: A pulmonary complication that adversely affects prognosis
mcqs.explanation: It is a pulmonary complication of liver disease that adversely affects prognosis.

sourceRefs.excerpt: pulmonary vascular complication of liver disease, which adversely affects prognosis

mcqs.question: The accepted review is about which syndrome?

options.B: Hepatorenal syndrome as the only topic
options.C: Portopulmonary hypertension as the title disease

mcqs.explanation: The source is a review of hepatopulmonary syndrome.
